defaults.speaker: Aiden
defaults.instruction: Calm technical narrator. Low, steady, and unhurried, with restrained warmth and clear sentence-final pauses.

segments.text: Local narration keeps unfinished scripts on the device and removes per-generation API cost.
The cold baseline starts a new process and reloads the same model for every scene.
OneLoad keeps the quantized Qwen model in Apple Silicon memory and renders the full scene manifest in one process.
